headline.title: SK Hynix raises $26.5B in the biggest foreign IPO in US history, is urged to build new US fabs
headline.summary: SK Hynix has raised $26.5 billion in the largest foreign IPO in U.S. history, highlighting the growing demand for AI chips. Following this milestone, there are calls for SK Hynix and Samsung to establish new semiconductor manufacturing facilities in the United States.

articles.title: Open source AI matters more than ever, according to Hugging Face’s Clem Delangue
articles.summary: Hugging Face CEO Clem Delangue emphasizes the increasing importance of open source AI, highlighting the company's role as a platform for sharing and accessing AI models and datasets. The platform is now utilized by approximately half of the Fortune 500 companies, reflecting a significant trend in the industry.

articles.title: Instagram’s Adam Mosseri: If you don’t like AI, ‘then you shouldn’t have it in your feed’
articles.summary: Instagram head Adam Mosseri stated that the platform will not filter out AI-generated content, suggesting that users who dislike it should adjust their feed preferences instead. He emphasized the importance of user choice in managing the visibility of AI content on the platform during a recent podcast interview.

articles.title: Would you host part of an AI data center in your home?
articles.summary: Sunrun is launching a pilot program that allows customers to host AI data center compute units in their homes, offering financial incentives for participation. The initiative aims to create a distributed AI compute network by utilizing residential spaces for additional processing power.

articles.title: Hugging Face’s CEO on why companies are done renting their AI
articles.summary: Hugging Face CEO Clem Delangue highlights the growing trend of companies moving away from renting AI solutions in favor of open-source models, which are increasingly being adopted by major corporations. The platform has become a key resource for AI developers, akin to GitHub, facilitating the sharing and downloading of models and datasets used by approximately half of the Fortune 500.

articles.title: How Deutsche Telekom is rewiring telecommunications with AI
articles.summary: Deutsche Telekom is integrating AI technologies to enhance customer service, streamline employee workflows, and optimize network operations. The company aims to establish itself as an AI-native telecommunications provider by leveraging advancements in AI, including those from OpenAI.

articles.title: Value generalisation: value correction
articles.summary: The article discusses the concept of value generalization in AI alignment, emphasizing its importance and potential sufficiency for achieving alignment. It presents a specific example of a reinforcement learning agent that recognizes and corrects its potentially flawed reward function based on human demonstrations.

articles.title: Robot Dogs, Teslas, and Rescue Helicopters: The UN AI Summit Was a Lot
articles.summary: The UN's AI for Good summit addressed the challenges of global governance in relation to rapidly advancing AI technologies, featuring discussions on various applications including robot dogs and rescue helicopters. Participants engaged in live coding sessions while exploring the urgent need for regulatory frameworks to keep pace with AI development.

articles.title: Microsoft’s carbon emissions went up 25 percent last year
articles.summary: Microsoft's carbon emissions rose by 25 percent in 2025, totaling 34 million metric tons, as noted in its 2026 sustainability report. The increase was attributed mainly to the company's expansion efforts, which have impacted its ability to meet climate goals.

articles.title: OpenAI says GPT 5.6 is the ‘preferred model’ for Microsoft Copilot 365 amid breakup chatter
articles.summary: OpenAI has announced that its GPT 5.6 model will serve as the preferred model for Microsoft Copilot 365, ensuring continued integration with Microsoft's productivity applications. This development comes amid ongoing discussions regarding the future of the partnership between OpenAI and Microsoft.

articles.title: A New Experiential Gallery Just Might Change Your Mind About AI Art
articles.summary: Dataland, described as the "world's first museum of AI arts," combines wearables and extensive Amazonian materials to create an immersive experience that integrates nature, biometrics, and art. The gallery aims to reshape perceptions of AI-generated artwork through interactive exhibits.

articles.title: Profiling in PyTorch (Part 3): Attention is all you profile
articles.summary: The article discusses the importance of profiling in PyTorch, focusing on how to analyze and optimize attention mechanisms within neural networks. It provides practical guidance on using profiling tools to identify performance bottlenecks and improve model efficiency.
